name: senderdeck
description: Email account routing and a gated social conversation workspace with brand rules and exact reply approvals.

interface.shortDescription: Manage email and review brand conversations safely.
interface.longDescription: Connect Google and Microsoft mailboxes with exact sender and draft confirmation. Configure customer workspaces, brand policies and social enquiries. Meta access requires platform approval and live asset validation; LinkedIn and unvalidated capabilities remain pending. Social replies require exact revision approval.
defaultPrompt: Search my connected inboxes for recent action items.
Draft a reply from the right account.
Show me the exact details before sending.
Show the selected brand and its available social capabilities.
